component.name: jmx
component.title: JMX
component.description: Receive the notifications of an MBean on a local or remote MBean server, or of a JMX monitor that observes an MBean attribute.
component.label: monitoring

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

jmx.handback.label: consumer
jmx.handback.description: The handback object that the consumer registered with its notification listener: the value of the handback option, or the monitor MBean when monitorType is set.

consumerOut.description: The notification as XML text, such as an AttributeChangeNotification or a MonitorNotification element; with format=raw the Notification object. The handback object is in the jmx.handback header

serverURL.description: The MBean server to connect to: platform for the platform MBean server of the JVM that runs Camel, or the JMX service URL of a remote MBean server, for example service:jmx:rmi:///jndi/rmi://localhost:1099/jmxrmi. The monitorType option works only with platform.

format.description: The format of the message body: xml for the notification as XML text, as defined by the notifications.xsd schema of camel-jmx, or raw for the javax.management.Notification object.

granularityPeriod.description: The period at which the monitor reads the value of the observed attribute (the granularity period of the JMX monitor). Only used with monitorType.

monitorType.description: The type of the JMX monitor to create: counter (CounterMonitor), gauge (GaugeMonitor) or string (StringMonitor). If set, the consumer registers a monitor MBean on the platform MBean server that observes the observedAttribute of the MBean, and receives the notifications of the monitor instead of those of the MBean. Only supported when serverURL is platform.

objectDomain.description: The domain of the ObjectName of the MBean to listen to, for example java.lang. With monitorType, the consumer also registers its monitor MBean in this domain.

objectName.description: The value of the name key of the ObjectName of the MBean to listen to: the consumer uses the ObjectName objectDomain:name=objectName. Set either this option or the objectProperties option, not both.

observedAttribute.description: The name of the MBean attribute to observe. With monitorType it is required, and the monitor observes this attribute. Without monitorType and without notificationFilter, the consumer receives only the AttributeChangeNotifications of this attribute, selected further by stringToCompare.

bridgeErrorHandler.label: consumer,advanced
bridgeErrorHandler.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exceptionHandler.label: consumer,advanced
exceptionHandler.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

exchangePattern.label: consumer,advanced
exchangePattern.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

executorService.label: advanced
executorService.description: A shared thread pool that routes the notifications of the consumers that use it. If not set, each consumer creates its own single-threaded pool, which routes its notifications one at a time in the order they arrive.

handback.label: advanced
handback.description: An object that the MBean server hands back with each notification, which the consumer puts in the jmx.handback header. With monitorType this option is not used, and the header holds the monitor MBean instead.

notificationFilter.label: advanced
notificationFilter.description: A javax.management.NotificationFilter that selects the notifications to receive. It replaces the filter that the consumer builds from observedAttribute and stringToCompare, and with monitorType it selects among the notifications of the monitor. A remote MBean server receives the filter serialized and applies it itself, so its class must be on the class path of that server.

objectProperties.label: advanced
objectProperties.description: The key properties of the ObjectName of the MBean to listen to, for example key.type=Threading for the ObjectName java.lang:type=Threading. Set either this option or the objectName option, not both. This is a multi-value option with prefix: key.

reconnectDelay.label: advanced
reconnectDelay.description: The number of seconds to wait before the next attempt to connect to a remote MBean server: at startup when testConnectionOnStartup is false, and after a lost connection when reconnectOnConnectionFailure is true.

reconnectOnConnectionFailure.label: advanced
reconnectOnConnectionFailure.description: Whether the consumer connects again to a remote MBean server when the connection is closed or fails, or notifications are lost. It tries every reconnectDelay seconds until it succeeds. When the JMX connector opens a new connection by itself, the consumer registers its listener again on that connection.

testConnectionOnStartup.label: advanced
testConnectionOnStartup.description: Whether the consumer fails to start when it cannot connect to a remote MBean server. If false, the consumer logs a warning and tries to connect again every reconnectDelay seconds until it succeeds.

initThreshold.label: counter
initThreshold.description: The initial threshold of the counter monitor, which sends a notification when the counter reaches or exceeds the threshold. The value is converted to the type of the observed attribute, which must be an integer type. If not set, the threshold is 0. Only used when monitorType is counter.

modulus.label: counter
modulus.description: The value at which the observed counter wraps around to zero. The counter monitor sets the threshold back to initThreshold when it exceeds this value, and in difference mode adds it to a negative difference. If not set (0), the counter is taken not to wrap around. Only used when monitorType is counter.

offset.label: counter
offset.description: The value that the counter monitor adds to the threshold each time the counter reaches it, so that it sends a notification each time the counter grows by this value. If not set (0), the threshold does not change. Only used when monitorType is counter.

differenceMode.label: counter,gauge
differenceMode.description: Whether the counter or gauge monitor compares the difference between two successive observations of the attribute with the thresholds, instead of the value of the attribute itself. Only used when monitorType is counter or gauge.

notifyHigh.label: gauge
notifyHigh.description: Whether the gauge monitor sends a notification when the observed value rises to or above thresholdHigh. After that it sends the next high notification only once the value has fallen to or below thresholdLow. When monitorType is gauge, notifyHigh, notifyLow or both must be true.

notifyLow.label: gauge
notifyLow.description: Whether the gauge monitor sends a notification when the observed value falls to or below thresholdLow. After that it sends the next low notification only once the value has risen to or above thresholdHigh. When monitorType is gauge, notifyHigh, notifyLow or both must be true.

thresholdHigh.label: gauge
thresholdHigh.description: The high threshold of the gauge monitor, converted to the type of the observed attribute. It must not be lower than thresholdLow. Required when monitorType is gauge.

thresholdLow.label: gauge
thresholdLow.description: The low threshold of the gauge monitor, converted to the type of the observed attribute. It must not be higher than thresholdHigh. Required when monitorType is gauge.

password.label: security
password.description: The password to authenticate with on a remote MBean server. The consumer passes user and password to the JMX connector as its credentials. Not used for the platform MBean server.

user.label: security
user.description: The user name to authenticate with on a remote MBean server. The consumer passes user and password to the JMX connector as its credentials. Not used for the platform MBean server.

notifyDiffer.label: consumer,string
notifyDiffer.description: Whether to receive a notification when the value of the observed attribute differs from stringToCompare. With monitorType string, the string monitor sends one each time the value starts to differ. Without monitorType, the consumer then receives the attribute changes whose new value differs from stringToCompare, instead of those whose new value matches it.

notifyMatch.label: consumer,string
notifyMatch.description: Whether the string monitor sends a notification each time the value of the observed attribute starts to match stringToCompare. When monitorType is string, notifyMatch, notifyDiffer or both must be true. Without monitorType this option is not used: the consumer receives the matching attribute changes unless notifyDiffer is true.

stringToCompare.label: consumer,string
stringToCompare.description: The text that the value of the observed attribute is compared with. Required when monitorType is string. Without monitorType, the consumer compares it with the new value of each AttributeChangeNotification of the observedAttribute (the text null matches a null value), and receives every change of the attribute when this option is not set.
